title: Can my child continue to go to school during Speech Therapy?
metaTitle: Balancing School and Speech Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network facilitates Speech Therapy sessions around your child's school schedule to ensure they don't miss out on their regular academics.
html: Of course! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand how important a regular schooling schedule is. While undergoing Speech Therapy in our centers, your child can certainly continue their schooling. We design our therapy sessions keeping in mind your child's school hours. Moreover, skills learnt in Speech Therapy often complement academic skills, facilitating overall development.
